entry.content: Cloud SQL for MySQLFeatureCloud SQL for MySQL now supports theinnodb_cloudsql_managed_buffer_pool_tuneup_pct database flag.Managed buffer pool automatically adjusts the InnoDB buffer pool size to reduceout-of-memory events. When instance memory usage remains at or below 70% for 10minutes or longer after prior reductions, Cloud SQL increases the buffer poolsize.
